mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in federal funds rate above 5.0% and CPI above 3.5% signals dual monetary tightening and persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), wage inflation risks trigger monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in retail sales (RSAFS) signals stronger consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth positive and 60-day forward returns negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index base 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and 5-day forward returns positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS decline and HOUST decline and 20-day forward returns positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery (UNRATE decline > 0.5pp from peak and PAYEMS growth > 0.8% MoM), initial earnings growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decline > 0.5pp from peak and PAYEMS growth > 0.8% MoM
failure_condition: UNRATE decline > 0.5pp from peak and PAYEMS growth > 0.8% MoM and 60-day forward returns negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
